title: Segfix: interactive correction of tree instance segmentation in forest point clouds
description:
Segfix is an open-source desktop application for finding and fixing errors in automatic instance segmentation of terrestrial and mobile laser scans into individual trees: crowns split across two IDs, two stems merged into one, branches handed to the wrong neighbour, ground swallowed into a trunk, and bushes detected as trees. It opens a segmented plot of hundreds of millions of points through a memory map, loads one tree with its spatial neighbours at a time, and offers a review loop in which every edit is a lasso or a click followed by one key. Saving patches only the label bytes that changed, so the file keeps its format, fields and coordinates byte for byte. Segfix also edits per-point classes such as leaf and wood, imports one-file-per-tree outputs, and matches the segmented trees to a field stem map on position, height and a fitted diameter at breast height. It reads the outputs of Sylva, raycloudtools and arbor directly.

Install with pip install segfix on Linux, Windows and macOS; a standalone Windows installer and portable zip are on the GitHub releases page.
